# Load packages and data:

```{r, message=FALSE}

# packages
if (!require(ggplot2)) {install.packages("ggplot2"); require(ggplot2)}
if (!require(plyr)) {install.packages("plyr"); require(plyr)}
if (!require(lme4)) {install.packages("lme4"); require(lme4)}
if (!require(reshape2)) {install.packages("reshape2"); require(reshape2)}
if (!require(MuMIn)) {install.packages("MuMIn"); require(MuMIn)}

# within-element error functions
source('within-element_error_functions.R')

# read in data
setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)) #set working directory to current directory (if not using RStudio, modify to the path you'd like)
data.raw <- read.table(file.path(getwd(), '..', 'Data', 'trial_data.tsv'), header=T)

# make some variables into factors
data.raw$experimentName <- factor(data.raw$experimentName)
data.raw$experimentVersion <- factor(data.raw$experimentVersion)
data.raw$experimentCondition <- factor(data.raw$experimentCondition)
data.raw$trialType <- factor(data.raw$trialType)
data.raw$probeType <- factor(data.raw$probeType)

```

Summarize:
```{r}

summary(data.raw)

```

```{r, include=FALSE}

accCutoff <- 0.75
lowrt <- 200
rtCutoff <- 0.10
respCutoff <- 0.95

dataraw.acc <- ddply(subset(data.raw, trialType == 'catch'),
                     .(subjectID), summarise,
                     meanAcc = mean(acc),
                     exclAcc = meanAcc < accCutoff)
dataraw.acc

dataraw.rt <- ddply(subset(data.raw, trialType=='test'),
                    .(subjectID), summarise,
                    meanRT = mean(rt),
                    medianRT = median(rt),
                    propFastRT = mean(rt < lowrt),
                    exclRT = propFastRT > rtCutoff)

dataraw.resp <- ddply(subset(data.raw, trialType=='test'),
                    .(subjectID), summarise,
                    meanResp = mean(respondCloser),
                    exclResp = meanResp > respCutoff | meanResp < (1-respCutoff))

dataraw.excl <- cbind(dataraw.acc, dataraw.rt, dataraw.resp)
dataraw.excl$exclude <- dataraw.excl$exclAcc | dataraw.excl$exclRT | dataraw.excl$exclResp

print(summary(dataraw.excl))

subset(dataraw.excl, select = c(subjectID, meanAcc, medianRT, propFastRT, meanResp, exclAcc, exclRT, exclResp, exclude))

data <- subset(data.raw, 
               trialType == 'test' & 
               subjectID %in% dataraw.excl$subjectID[dataraw.excl$exclude == FALSE])

```

# Exclusions:
* Initial data: `r length(unique(data.raw$subjectID))` participants
* Exclusions:
    * Low accuracy on catch trials (< `r round(100*accCutoff)`%): `r length(dataraw.excl$subjectID[dataraw.excl$exclAcc==TRUE])` participant(s)
    * Many RTs impossibly fast (> `r round(100*rtCutoff)`% of RTs < `r lowrt` ms): `r length(dataraw.excl$subjectID[dataraw.excl$exclRT==TRUE])` participant(s)
    * More than `r round(100*respCutoff)`% of trials with the same response: `r length(dataraw.excl$subjectID[dataraw.excl$exclResp==TRUE])` participant(s)
* Final data: `r length(unique(data$subjectID))` participants
```{r, include=FALSE}

prop.lowrt <- mean(data$rt < lowrt)
ntrials.lowrt <- sum(data$rt < lowrt)

# exclude the remaining bad trials
data <- subset(data, rt > lowrt)

# re-factorize certain variables
data$subjectID <- factor(data$subjectID)
data$identity <- factor(data$identity)
data$category <- factor(data$category)

# re-order category factor levels
data$category <- factor(data$category, levels = c('scene','obj'))

# set up contrasts and centering
contrasts(data$category) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
data$trialNum_c <- scale(data$trialNum, center=T, scale=F)

# add a scaled response column
data <- ddply(data, .(subjectID), transform,
              respondCloser.z = scale(respondCloser))

# final data
data.final <- data

```
    * and exclude remaining low RT trials (`r round(100*prop.lowrt, 2)`%, or `r ntrials.lowrt` trials)

# RT distribution and stats:
* histogram across all RTs (cutoff 10 sec, for display purposes)
* boxplot across subject median RTs
```{r}

maxRT <- 10000
summary(data.final$rt[data.final$rt < maxRT])
hist(data.final$rt[data.final$rt < maxRT])

# by subjects
tmp <- ddply(data.final, .(subjectID), summarise,
      medianRT = median(rt))
boxplot(tmp$medianRT)

```

# Results: 

```{r, results="hide"}
data.subj <- ddply(data.final, .(subjectID, category), summarise,
                   meanRespCloser = mean(respondCloser),
                   meanRespCloser.z = mean(respondCloser.z))
data.item <- ddply(data.final, .(identity, category), summarise,
                   meanRespCloser = mean(respondCloser),
                   meanRespCloser.z = mean(respondCloser.z))

# create wide-format data frames
data.subj.wide <- reshape(data.subj, 
                             idvar=c('subjectID'), timevar='category', direction = 'wide')
data.subj.wide$spherized_BE <- data.subj.wide$meanRespCloser.obj - data.subj.wide$meanRespCloser.scene
data.subj.wide$spherized_BE.z <- data.subj.wide$meanRespCloser.z.obj - data.subj.wide$meanRespCloser.z.scene

data.item.wide <- reshape(data.item,
                               idvar=c('identity'), timevar='category', direction = 'wide')
data.item.wide$spherized_BE <- data.item.wide$meanRespCloser.obj - data.item.wide$meanRespCloser.scene
data.item.wide$spherized_BE.z <- data.item.wide$meanRespCloser.z.obj - data.item.wide$meanRespCloser.z.scene

```

### condition means
* original: M=`r round(100*mean(data.subj.wide$meanRespCloser.scene), 2)`%
* spherized: M=`r round(100*mean(data.subj.wide$meanRespCloser.obj), 2)`%

### number of subjects/items in the direction of the effect
* subjects: `r sum(data.subj.wide$spherized_BE > 0)`/`r nrow(data.subj.wide)` (`r round(100*mean(data.subj.wide$spherized_BE > 0), 2)`%) in the direction of the effect
* items: `r sum(data.item.wide$spherized_BE > 0)`/`r nrow(data.item.wide)` (`r round(100*mean(data.item.wide$spherized_BE > 0), 2)`%) in the direction of the effect

## Mixed effects logistic regression:
* accounts for simultaneous subject and item random effects
```{r}

lm.0 <- glmer(respondCloser ~ 1 + trialNum_c + 
                 (1 + category | subjectID) + 
                 (1 + category | identity),
              data = data.final,
              family = binomial(link='logit'))
lm.1 <- update(lm.0, . ~ . + category)
lm.2 <- update(lm.0, . ~ . + category + trialNum_c:category)

anova(lm.0, lm.1, lm.2)

summary(lm.1)

# coefficients
coefs <- summary(lm.1)$coefficients[3,]

```
* beta = `r round(coefs[1], 3)`, 95% CI = `r round(coefs[1] + c(-1,1)*1.96*coefs[2], 2)`, z = `r round(coefs[3],2)`, p = `r round(coefs[4],2)`
* odds-ratio beta = `r round(exp(coefs[1]), 3)`, 95% CI = `r round(exp(coefs[1] + c(-1,1)*1.96*coefs[2]), 2)`

## calculate Pseudo-$R^2$
```{r}

# calculate pseudo-R^2 for full model
r2_lm.1 <- r.squaredGLMM(lm.1, lm.0)
r2_lm.1_m <- r2_lm.1[1,1]
r2_lm.1_c <- r2_lm.1[1,2]

```
* $R^2_{m}$ = `r round(r2_lm.1_m, 3)`
* $R^2_{c}$ = `r round(r2_lm.1_c, 3)`

## Summarized across subjects:
```{r, echo=FALSE}

dc <- summarySEwithin(data.subj, measurevar="meanRespCloser", withinvars=c("category"),
                      idvar="subjectID", na.rm=FALSE, conf.interval=.95)
jitter <- position_jitter(width = 0.07, height = 0.01, seed=12345)
pl <- ggplot(data = data.subj, aes(x=category, y=meanRespCloser)) +
   geom_hline(yintercept=0.5, alpha = 0.75, size=1, linetype = 'dashed') + 
   # individual data
   geom_violin(aes(x=category, y=meanRespCloser, alpha=0.3, fill=category, width=0.4)) +
   scale_fill_manual(values=c("#2F5597", "#C55A11")) +
   geom_line(color="gray", aes(alpha=0.4, group=subjectID),
             position = jitter) +
   geom_point(color="gray", fill="gray", shape=21, size=2, aes(alpha=0.4, group=subjectID), 
              position = jitter) +
   # now the average data
   geom_line(data = dc, size=1, aes(x=category, y=meanRespCloser, group=1)) +
   geom_errorbar(data = dc, size=1, aes(group = 1, x=category, y=meanRespCloser, ymin=meanRespCloser-ci, ymax=meanRespCloser+ci), width=.03) +
   geom_point(data = dc, aes(x=category, y=meanRespCloser, fill=category, group=1), shape=21, size=8) +
   theme_bw() +
   theme(legend.position = "none",
         axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
         axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
         axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
         axis.text = element_text(size = 28),
         axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold", color=c("#2F5597", "#C55A11")),
         strip.text = element_text(size = 18),
         panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
         plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent",colour = NA), 
         text = element_text(family="Gill Sans")) +
   scale_x_discrete(labels = c('Far-Away\n(Original)', 'Close-Up\n(Spherized)')) +
   ylim(0-.02,1+.02)
pl

```
